question: The square root of 0.0009 is:
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Count the **decimal places** in the number: 0.0009 has **4 decimal places**. The **square root** will have exactly **half** the number of decimal places: 4 ÷ 2 = **2 decimal places**. Square root of 9 is 3. Adjusting to 2 decimal places gives **0.03**. **∴ The correct answer is 0.03.**
